summary: Add guest_queries table migration (no users/sessions FK; cost + converted_user_id columns)
description: Depends on nothing else; must land BEFORE the guest query path. New migration migrations/016_guest_queries.sql creating guest_queries: id PK; ip TEXT; ip_name TEXT; guest_token_hash TEXT; query_text TEXT NOT NULL; response_text TEXT NOT NULL; chunks_used JSONB NOT NULL; model_used TEXT; input_tokens INT; output_tokens INT; cached_input_tokens INT; cost_usd NUMERIC; converted_user_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(). Index on created_at DESC and on converted_user_id. Rationale: keeps the queries table's user_id/session_id NOT NULL invariant (defended in 015) intact; guest data is segregated for easy retention/purge and clean conversion modeling. converted_user_id IS NULL = a non-converted guest.
